 Noel Surrey Christmas festival and night market opens Nov. 27 in Cloverdale
 Published 5:45 am Friday, November 13, 2026
 By Malin Jordan 
 Festival-goers attend Noel Surrey with the magic of Bright Nights in 2025. This year the festival returns Nov. 27 
 (Photo: Malin Jordan/Cloverdale Reporter) 
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 One of the Lower Mainland’s largest festival of lights opens at the end of the month on the Cloverdale Fairgrounds.
 Noel Surrey opens Nov. 27 and runs until Dec. 29 bringing Christmas cheer festival attendees for more than one month.
 Billed this year as “Noel Surrey with the Magic of Bright Nights,” the third annual holiday celebration incorporates the largest annual fundraiser for the B.C. Professional Firefighters Burn Fund . A portion of every ticket purchased will go to support the Burn Fund. (Before last year, Bright Nights ran for nearly three decades in Stanley Park.)
 Organizers say the festival will be bigger than last year as they are expanding their indoor, heated space. They’re also offering ticket rescheduling and transfers.
 “Don’t worry about buying your ticket too early,” notes info from Noel Surrey. “Our new ticketing provider will allow you to transfer your ticket to someone else or exchange for another date or time slot. Ticket exchanges to another event date or time slot are unlimited, but must be completed at least 8 hours before your current booking.”
 Also new this year is the Snow Barn. Set in a new 9,000 sq-ft heated indoor space, festival-goers can get Santa photos, visit a holiday bar, wander through an expanded Christmas Market (featuring more than 20 local vendors), and put their feet up in a new lounge area with additional washrooms.
 “Stay warm, shop local, and meet Santa, all in one place.”
 Noel Surrey will have more than 1 million lights on display. The Cloverdale Agriplex will again be transformed into Noel Village. There’ll be a Bavarian Plaza, Jack Frost’s Bar, Noel Village Bar, Winter Spice Kitchen, and—along with food trucks—a dining hub and fire pits.
 Along with free parking, tickets include: admission to the grounds, Bright Nights, photos will Santa, photos with Green and Grumpy One, meet and greets and singalongs with the Snow Sisters, unlimited Ferris wheel rides, unlimited rides on the Candy Cane Slide (ages 6-12), illuminated playground with LED seesaws and swings, live music and dance performances, face painting, balloon twisting, crafts, and Rudolph’s Ranch Ride-On-Reindeers (ages 2-6).
 Noel Surrey will be open from 3 – 9:30 p.m. each day. The festival runs from Nov. 27 to Dec. 29, but will be closed for four days over that period: Nov. 30, Dec. 7, 24, and 25.
 Tickets for Noel Surrey cost between $18 and $20 for youth (7-18) and seniors (65+), and between $24 and $27 for adults, service fees (approx. $3-$4.50 per ticket) and taxes are both extra. Kids 6-and-under are free.
 The Cloverdale Fairgrounds are located at 17905 62nd Avenue in Surrey.
 For more info, visit noelfestival.com .
